params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection. Defaults to 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items returned. Verified live: values outside 1-100 return HTTP 400 rest_invalid_param.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines the fields present in the response. Only view and embed are available anonymously.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to limit the response to. Verified live.

params.name: media_type
params.description: Limit results to attachments of a specific media type.

params.name: mime_type
params.description: Limit results to attachments of a specific MIME type.

params.name: parent
params.description: Limit results to attachments attached to the given post IDs.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit results to attachments with one of the given slugs.

items.docs: Returns a paginated collection of media attachments. Counts come back in X-WP-Total / X-WP-TotalPages.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier for the object.

params.name: _fields
